summary: Plan social campaigns, manage communities, and measure results with practical frameworks and templates. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Social media management coordinates planning, publishing, moderation, and evaluation across social platforms. For social media managers, digital communication specialists, and content strategists, the practical work includes audience research, campaign briefs, editorial calendars, and community response workflows. Learners apply RACE and AMEC concepts to set measurable objectives, interpret platform and UTM-tracked analytics, and create reports that guide channel decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, publish, measure, or govern organizational social media activity and need practical methods for improving day-to-day channel operations. This course is designed for: Social Media Managers coordinating channel calendars, publishing, and performance reviews. Digital Communication Specialists aligning social posts with organizational communication plans. Community Managers moderating conversations and routing sensitive issues for response. Social Media Strategists translating audience research into channel priorities and campaign briefs. Content Strategists mapping platform formats to audience needs and editorial themes. Paid Social Specialists reviewing campaign objectives, audience settings, and platform results. Communications Analysts connecting social engagement data with web outcomes and reporting. Brand Managers maintaining voice, approvals, and consistency across social channels. Customer Experience Managers defining social response workflows for service inquiries. Public Relations Officers monitoring social conversations and coordinating reputational escalation.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: You should have experience using social media professionally or supporting organizational communications. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with basic channel metrics is useful; exercises use templates and sample data, so live platform accounts and advertising spend are not required.
